newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND DEFY MUD TO SINK QUINS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND DEFY MUD TO SINK QUINS.

text.p: Super 12 champions Auckland continued their European warm-up to this year's tournament by slogging through thick English mud to beat Harlequins 33-29 on Tuesday.

Heavy rain turned the Stoop Memorial Ground pitch into a quagmire but the New Zealand province, featuring 11 players with international experience, still managed to score five tries to overturn a 22-12 halftime deficit.

Harlequins paid the price for substituting five internationals, including Will Carling and Frenchman Thierry Lacroix, at the interval but conditions made life almost impossible for both sides at times.
Auckland now travel to France to face European Cup champions Brive on Saturday before heading for South Africa to begin their Super 12 campaign the following weekend.
